about_the_game:
21-minute Pilgrims Original Soundtrack from acclaimed composer and musician Tomas Dvorak aka Floex.

Full game sold separately.

Soundtrack files (mp3+flac) will be located in the following folder upon installation:
PC: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\music\"
Mac: "/Users/USERNAME/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/music"
